_comment: Example §13.3 operating-point table. DATA, not code — schema only. Constants seeded from waybeam_wfb_ng link_controller (docs/groundwork.md); NOT a validated flight table.

units.tx_power_level: PORTABLE power INTENT index (§14.2). NOT an absolute value. Each TX node resolves (adapter, mcs, level) -> an absolute devourer setting via that adapter's LOCAL power map (per-adapter, no regulatory clamp — §14.2.1). Absolute power never lives in this shared on-air table.
units.airtime_budget_frac: fraction of wall-clock airtime this link may occupy
units.arq_deadline_ms: per importance class; iframe class is longer (§4.1/§8)

_per_adapter_power: Absolute per-MCS power is authored per physical adapter in a LOCAL file (PHY_REG_PG.txt row format, §14.2), e.g. profiles/txpower.<adapter-id>.txt — one per adapter because each has its own efuse calibration/antenna. Not shipped here; node-local and operator-owned.
